extra.summary: Now packed with even more miles, DBS Altitude Card is one of the best entry-level miles credit cards in Singapore. With up to 2.2 miles per S$1 on your spend, it’s the fastest way to turn your life into Miles for Life. It also offers 1 year annual fee waiver, 10,000 bonus miles when you pay for your annual fee, complimentary digital Priority Pass membership with 2 free lounge visits per membership year and amazing travel deals.

our_takes.our-take: The DBS Altitude Visa Signature is a solid miles card for those who want fuss-free earning, especially since DBS Points never expire. Earning 1.3 miles locally and up to 2.2 miles overseas is competitive. The included Priority Pass gives two complimentary lounge visits annually – useful for occasional travellers. However, the S$27.25 conversion fee applies each time you transfer DBS Points to airline miles, so consolidate redemptions. While the annual fee is waived the first year, you'll need to spend $25,000 annually to get subsequent waivers, otherwise it's $196.20. Consider if your spending habits align to maximize this benefit.
our_takes.good-for:
Ideal for frequent travelers seeking accelerated miles on overseas spending and complimentary lounge access.
Suited for young professionals who want to earn miles on dining, shopping, and everyday local expenditure.
Good for miles enthusiasts who value points that don’t expire, offering long-term redemption flexibility.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fee of S$196.20 applies after the first year; ensure your rewards offset this cost.
S$27.25 fee applies per conversion of DBS Points to miles, factor this into redemption planning.
Supplementary cards have annual fees of S$98.10, weigh the benefits against this additional cost.
